results.title: Clean imaging dataset split package for DOI release
recommendedActions: Release split manifests with normal artifact provenance.

results.title: Clinical split package with patient leakage and embargoed rows

findings.message: One or more records appear in multiple splits.
findings.remediation: Regenerate split manifests with disjoint record identifiers and new manifest hashes.

findings.message: A participant, patient, subject, lab, or other grouping identifier appears across multiple splits.
findings.remediation: Regenerate splits with group-level disjointness to prevent leakage across train/validation/test boundaries.

findings.message: The split generation seed or script hash is missing.
findings.remediation: Attach deterministic seed and split-script hash evidence before DOI/API release.

findings.message: One or more split manifests lack checksum or manifest hash evidence.
findings.remediation: Add per-split content checksums and manifest hashes before release.

findings.message: Split manifests have inconsistent license or access states.
findings.remediation: Align license and access state across splits or document why a split must remain restricted.

findings.message: Class or stratum balance differs from the dataset policy beyond the allowed threshold.
findings.remediation: Regenerate stratified splits or document the imbalance in the release notes.

findings.message: Embargoed records are present in one or more release split manifests.
findings.remediation: Remove embargoed records or keep the affected split private until embargo restrictions are lifted.

findings.message: Public DOI/API release is enabled while split-integrity findings remain unresolved.
findings.remediation: Freeze DOI/API/public-preview release until split integrity issues are resolved.

recommendedActions: Freeze public DOI/API release and reproducibility badges.
Attach findings to the dataset release review packet.
Regenerate split manifests or document curator-approved exceptions.
Re-run checksum, license, access, and stratification checks before DOI/API release.
